# fastGMA documentation (full text)

This file collects the fastGMA documentation ({{ '/' | absolute_url }}) and the output of `fastgma -h <n>` for every mode in one plain-text file, for AI assistants and offline reading. Each page is given in its Markdown source, starting with its front matter (title, description). The `fastgma -h <n>` output at the end is the authoritative list of options and defaults.
